title: Files sidebar: starred tree search must be mirrored from the project tree via navFilesTabLogic
answers: Why doesn't the Starred section in the Files sidebar filter when I search?
How is the starred files tree kept in sync with the Filter files search?
Starred section stays visible/empty after searching files in simple sidebar
body:
The Files tab renders two projectTreeLogic instances: the project tree (`FILES_TREE_KEY`, root `project://`) and the starred tree (`FILES_STARRED_TREE_KEY`, root `shortcuts://`, shortcutScope `files`). Only the project tree owns the search input.
`navFilesTabLogic` (frontend/src/layout/panel-layout/navbar/tabs/navFilesTabLogic.ts) listens to the project tree's `setSearchTerm` and `clearSearch` and forwards them to the starred tree. It must be mounted (NavTabFiles uses `useValues(navFilesTabLogic)`; stories use `useMountedLogic(navFilesTabLogic)`), otherwise starred files stop filtering and never restore after clearing.
Always import the two tree keys from navFilesTabLogic instead of hardcoding 'navbar-files' strings, since the logic and the components must build identical logic keys/props.
Regression test: navFilesTabLogic.test.ts.
applies: Simple sidebar (simple-sidepanel flag) Files tab in frontend/src/layout/panel-layout/navbar/tabs
